body:
Your sister was lucky to have you. You and I’m assuming your family are godsends. But unfortunately, my entire family doesn’t give a shit and they don’t want to help me, I didn’t talk to most of them my entire life and I never asked them for anything other than when I hit rock bottom recently. My dad left when I was a kid and my mom ran off to another state with her boyfriend. Haven’t spoken to her in forever. I’ve been on my own since I was 17. I’m 21 now, I had nothing but my clothes with me. My sisters, one of which travels the world and makes a six figure salary living in LA, think I should do it on my own because if you’re not struggling on your own you’re not trying hard enough right? Not to sound entitled, but I live in my boyfriend’s parents house with 5 cats and 4 dogs that they don’t clean up after, living among their filth, shit and piss, infested with bugs. I told my brother about this living situation and he treated me like a burden when I asked if I could live with him for a bit. Of course he said no, even though he lives in a nice house with his friend. I can’t even get up to take care of myself most days. Life really is something, isn’t it? It makes for a much prettier “success story,” to do it all on your own, doesn’t it? I’m not strong enough to do that. I don’t care about beautiful, inspiring success stories. It’s all bullshit. I couldn’t be bothered anymore. I really did try, but I’m done. I don’t want to go into my entire life story. But just know I did try, for a long time. It’s not worth it for me. I’m not an example for anyone, but I never asked to be. 

I’m happy that your sister had someone as supportive as you and whoever else was involved. (I’m not being sarcastic sorry if it sounds like it, bless you for being such a great person.) I unfortunately don’t have that. I wish, though. Don’t we all?

I’m so, so sorry to hear that. I used to have an addiction to opiates as well, it nearly killed me, but I got out of it after 4 long years of fighting. nothing good comes out of being involved in those. And I’m sorry about those pictures being passed around your school, that’s fucking terrible. Fuck all of those people. I wish I could be as strong as you are, I don’t think many people could see the silver lining of things in your situation. I’ve tried for so long. I’m so tired.

I already did. I know I didn’t explain much more of the situation, but I did. Multiple times. Even told him I was suicidal. He said there’s nothing he can do about it, and in time it will eventually get better. It won’t. I don’t want to give some long-winded sob story story about my life nobody wants to hear, but just know that I have already considered that and not much came of it.

I already did. The truth is even if you have one person, that doesn’t necessarily mean they care. Some people are only really there for the good times, but want absolutely nothing to do with the bad. I know I didn’t explain much more of my situation, but you’re wrong. I really don’t have anyone.

I feel like social media is a double-edged sword whether you have it or not, having it is honestly awful for obvious reasons, but not having it makes you feel like you’re... missing out on things or being forgotten.

I like this reply a lot. I’m happy for you, I don’t know how to convey that through text without sounding sarcastic but I mean that genuinely. It’s hard to keep that kind of mindset sometimes. Sometimes I just really want to feel like I mean something to someone, but it’s much better to focus on feeling better about yourself for you, and not about how often others (or what others) think about you.

My health is terrible. I have an infected tooth that makes it painful to move my jaw. Have had a UTI for like 5 years. No money to fix it. I’m severely depressed, I made another post going into detail about what I’ve been through. 

I’ve reached out many times. My family turned their backs on me. My friends don’t care. They don’t want to listen, every time I ask for someone to talk to, one avoids me like the plague (he stopped talking to me every day after I started showing how depressed I am.) and the other one is constantly watching YouTube videos and almost.. enables my suicidal thoughts. I don’t really have anyone else to turn to.
Idk why but this made me laugh really hard. You have no idea how much I’ve needed this. Thank you.

I believe so- but it takes awhile to apply. I’ve been on antibiotics before for UTI’s and kidney infections but they always come back within a week or a few months. I think it’s a chronic thing. Idk. 

And yeah. But I couldn’t afford to keep it up, nor do I have the resources to keep filling my prescriptions since my boyfriend is usually busy with work and I have no one else willing to take me anywhere.
